gap: No result ChatGPT got states that every Avalon bottleless cooler it pointed shoppers to (A5, A7, A12) runs on one two-filter refill, Avalon's dual replacement set (A5 sediment + A4 carbon block). The set is $99.99 on avalonh2o.com and is rated 1,500 gallons or 6 months, so it costs about $200 a year. Avalon's reverse-osmosis A5-RO is excluded: it needs a different four-filter set at $129.99.
standout_why: Bob Vila is the only cited page. For its A12 bottleless pick it says only that the sediment and carbon-block filters need replacing periodically, with no part number, price, life or list of models that take them. Jeffdsmith.com covers filters only for a Waterdrop countertop unit, and its Avalon pick is the bottled A4. Bottle-size fit (3 or 5 gal) is already on both pages, so that part is not new. I did not open shouldit, popularmechanics, my-best or the listicle sites.
decides: It confirms the bottled-versus-bottleless split ChatGPT asks about, with a real number. A bottleless Avalon's sticker price ($199.99–$299.99) comes with about $200 a year of filters. A bottom-load A4 has no filters but takes any 3 or 5 gal jug. A buyer of an RO model must buy the four-filter set, not the common two-filter set.
